Here’s a quick step‑by‑step guide (and a handy `curl` example) for pulling comments from **apple.com** using your `delta_key`.

---

## 1️⃣ Build the Request URL

```
GET https://api.commentdown.com/v1/domains/apple.com/comments
```

### Optional Query Parameters  
You can add any of the following to fine‑tune the results (comma‑separated values where applicable):

| Parameter | Description | Example |
|-----------|-------------|---------|
| `limit`   | Max number of comments per page (default 25, max 1000) | `limit=50` |
| `offset`  | Skip the first N comments (for pagination) | `offset=100` |
| `sort_by` | Field to sort on (`created_at`, `updated_at`, `deleted_at`) | `sort_by=created_at` |
| `sort_order` | `asc` or `desc` (default `desc`) | `sort_order=asc` |
| `start_date` | ISO‑8601 start date/time for filtering | `start_date=2024-01-01T00:00:00Z` |
| `end_date`   | ISO‑8601 end date/time for filtering | `end_date=2024-12-31T23:59:59Z` |
| `comment_type` | `post`, `reply`, `moderated`, `removed`, `spam` | `comment_type=post,reply` |
| `comment_status` | `approved`, `flagged`, `reported`, `replied` | `comment_status=approved,flagged` |
| `comment_source` | `web`, `mobile`, `api` | `comment_source=web,mobile` |
| `comment_language` | ISO‑639‑1 code | `comment_language=en,es` |
| `comment_sentiment` | `positive`, `neutral`, `negative` | `comment_sentiment=positive,negative` |
| `comment_category` | `product`, `support`, `feedback`, `other` | `comment_category=product,feedback` |
| `comment_subcategory` | `hardware`, `software`, `services` | `comment_subcategory=hardware,software` |
| `comment_content` | Full text search (case‑insensitive) | `comment_content=great+service` |
| `comment_title` | Search title field | `comment_title=awesome+app` |
| `comment_author` | Author name | `comment_author=John+Doe` |
| `comment_url` | Exact URL match | `comment_url=https%3A%2F%2Fapple.com%2Fproduct%2F12345` |
| `comment_ip_address` | IP address | `comment_ip_address=192.168.1.1` |
| `comment_user_agent` | User‑agent string | `comment_user_agent=Mozilla/5.0` |
| `comment_device` | Device type (`desktop`, `mobile`, `tablet`) | `comment_device=mobile` |
| `comment_os` | Operating system (`iOS`, `Android`, `Windows`) | `comment_os=iOS,Android` |
| `comment_browser` | Browser name (`Chrome`, `Safari`, `Firefox`) | `comment_browser=Chrome,Safari` |
| `comment_country` | Country code (`US`, `GB`, `DE`) | `comment_country=US,GB` |
| `comment_region` | Region/state | `comment_region=CA,NY` |
| `comment_city` | City name | `comment_city=San+Francisco,New+York` |
| `comment_latitude` | Latitude (decimal) | `comment_latitude=37.7749` |
| `comment_longitude` | Longitude (decimal) | `comment_longitude=-122.4194` |
| `comment_post_id` | ID of the post the comment belongs to | `comment_post_id=987654321` |
| `comment_parent_id` | ID of the parent comment (for replies) | `comment_parent_id=123456789` |
| `comment_created_at` | Filter by creation timestamp (ISO‑8601) | `comment_created_at=2024-01-01T00:00:00Z` |
| `comment_updated_at` | Filter by last update timestamp | `comment_updated_at=2024-02-01T00:00:00Z` |
| `comment_deleted_at` | Filter by deletion timestamp | `comment_deleted_at=2024-03-01T00:00:00Z` |
| `comment_approved_at` | Filter by approval timestamp | `comment_approved_at=2024-04-01T00:00:00Z` |
| `comment_flagged_at` | Filter by flagging timestamp | `comment_flagged_at=2024-05-01T00:00:00Z` |
| `comment_spam_at` | Filter by spam timestamp | `comment_spam_at=2024-06-01T00:00:00Z` |
| `comment_moderated_at` | Filter by moderation timestamp | `comment_moderated_at=2024-07-01T00:00:00Z` |
| `comment_removed_at` | Filter by removal timestamp | `comment_removed_at=2024-08-01T00:00:00Z` |
| `comment_reported_at` | Filter by reporting timestamp | `comment_reported_at=2024-09-01T00:00:00Z` |
| `comment_replied_at` | Filter by reply timestamp | `comment_replied_at=2024-10-01T00:00:00Z` |

> **Tip:** Combine multiple filters to narrow down the dataset. For example:
> ```
> ?limit=100&sort_by=created_at&sort_order=asc&comment_status=approved,flagged&comment_language=en,es
> ```

---

## 2️⃣ Set the Authorization Header

Add your `delta_key` as a bearer token:

```
Authorization: Bearer YOUR_DELTA_KEY_HERE
```

Replace `YOUR_DELTA_KEY_HERE` with the actual key you received when you signed up.

---

## 3️⃣ Example `curl` Command

```bash
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer YOUR_DELTA_KEY_HERE" \
     "https://api.commentdown.com/v1/domains/apple.com/comments?limit=50&sort_by=created_at&sort_order=asc"
```

This command fetches the first 50 comments for `apple.com`, sorted chronologically (oldest first). Adjust the query string to suit your needs.

---

## 4️⃣ Handling Pagination

The API returns a `pagination` object in the response:

```json
{
  "comments": [ ... ],
  "pagination": {
    "total": 1250,
    "limit": 50,
    "offset": 0,
    "next_offset": 50,
    "prev_offset": null
  }
}
```

Use `next_offset` to fetch subsequent pages:

```
?limit=50&offset=50
```

Continue until `next_offset` is `null`.
